answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 38 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in forge, queued in ember, and nadir publishes the wait time. A farm of 62 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4539 identities would post 2077 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
